provenance_claim_correction: metadata.json previously listed provenance/producer.log in file_sha256 with a hash, but that file is absent from the working tree AND from every ref including the publication commit -- `git log --all -- '*/provenance/*'` returns nothing, so it was never captured. verify_artifact.py therefore raised FileNotFoundError before checking anything, which made a broken verifier look like an unrun one. The claim is REMOVED rather than satisfied: there is no authoritative copy to restore and fabricating a producer log would be inventing provenance. The entry hashed c53c272e554edc0ab6f158f4c89bd37837dbc0131f9eaf3899f1c28915c6a476 when claimed; recorded here so the removal is auditable.
